// diagnostic E0732

Jet.MethodInTag

The tag `{tag}` declares a method `{method}`, but tags have no methods.

What

The tag `{tag}` declares a method `{method}`, but tags have no methods.

Why

A value tag is a field-less struct that erases at runtime; only a `trait` carries methods and dispatches.

Fix

Make `{tag}` a `trait` if `{method}` should dispatch, or remove the method to keep `{tag}` a value tag.

Worked example
